trigger.description: The workspace config sets [journal] enabled = false. Journal surfaces succeed with a clean refusal: no row is read or written, the data payload is empty, and an info-severity journal_disabled degraded entry explains the config gate (ADR 0062 §7).
trigger.invocation: ee journal append 'observation that will not land' --workspace . --json

notes: Capture must not silently drop evidence: the refusal is explicit (status journal_disabled + degraded entry) so a harness hook can detect the gate instead of assuming the entry landed.
